{{Quote|So it was a bomb.''"<br />"''Yes, Master, someone is trying to murder you.|Lando Calrissian and Vuffi Raa|<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Countdown_to_death.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] security chip bomb - [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] display says "ACTIVATE" and "COUNTDOWN TO [[Death/Legends|DEATH]]"]]
A '''bomb''' was an explosive device. Types of bomb included: [[ammonia bomb]], [[anti-matter bomb]], [[atomic compression bomb]], [[Baradium bomb/Legends|baradium bomb]], [[Cluster bomb/Legends|cluster bombs]] such as the [[CL-3 antistarfighter cluster bomb]] and the [[magnepulse bomb]], [[Concussion bomb/Legends|concussion bomb]], [[core bomb]], [[disruptor bomb]], [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], [[energy bomb]], [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash bomb]], [[Gas bomb/Legends|gas bomb]], [[glop bomb]], [[gravity bomb]], [[incremental-sequence bomb]], [[Ion bomb/Legends|ion bomb]], [[Jedi shadow bomb]], the [[M-12]], [[neutron bomb]], [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear bombs]] such as the [[fission bomb]], [[parasite bomb]], [[plague bomb]], [[Plasma bomb/Legends|plasma bomb]], [[pressure bomb]], [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]], [[radiation bomb]], [[talking bomb]], [[thermal bomb]], [[Thermite bomb/Legends|thermite bomb]], [[thought bomb]], [[time bomb]]s such as the [[TB-47 time bomb]], [[tow-cable bomb]], the [[XG Anti-Gravity Field Bomb]], and the [[Zicx-bug bomb]]. The [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] [[Bomb (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Bomb'']] was named after the explosive device.
